node.title: Re: XML::Twig - Parsing XML file with incorrect encoding in declaration
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Although I normally don't like editing XML files with anything other than a proper module, in this case it might be appropriate. Also, luckily, the declaration happens right at the top of the file. The following will work if the only change you are making is "utf-16" to "utf-8", obviously it won't work if the name of the target encoding is longer...

open my $fh, '+<:utf8', 'file.in.xml' or die $!; my $line = <$fh>; $line=~s/<\?xml.+encoding="\Kutf-16"/utf-8" / or die "didn't match line: '$line'"; seek $fh,0,0 or die $!; print $fh $line; close $fh;
